stories.name: Overview
stories.snippet:
const Overview = () => (

Schatten

A design system inspired by Japanese calligraphy — ink on paper.
Built with React, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, and class-variance-authority.

Concept

Schatten — the beauty in shadows

"Schatten" is the German word for "shadow." Inspired by Jun'ichiro Tanizaki's{' '} In Praise of Shadows (陰翳礼讃), this design system finds beauty not in light, but in the subtle interplay of shadow and restraint. Rather than commanding attention with bold decoration and animation, we let the content itself stand forward — through whitespace, muted tones, and quiet refinement.

Ink & Paper — the foundation

The color system is built on the metaphor of sumi (ink) on washi{' '} (paper). The warmth of handmade paper, the depth of layered ink, and the vermillion seal of a calligrapher's signature — these are not decorations but the DNA of every token and component. Light and dark modes are simply two sides of the same sheet.

Restraint as expression

A restrained UI is not a lack of design — it is a deliberate choice to let the work speak. Minimal color, subtle transitions, and typographic precision create a quiet confidence. The design recedes so the content can resonate.

Colors

Schatten's color system is inspired by Japanese calligraphy — ink on paper. The consistent use of color in our design system keeps cognitive loads low and makes for a unified and accessible user experience. Colors adapt automatically between light and dark mode.

Semantic Colors

These tokens are used in components. They automatically adapt to light/dark mode.

Primitive Palette

Core brand colors inspired by Japanese calligraphy. These are fixed values that do not change between light and dark mode. Components should use semantic tokens above instead.

Ink & Paper
Color Scales Primary

Primary color scale mapped from theme tokens. The default theme uses blue; seasonal themes override this entire scale.

Gray

Neutral gray scale defined in OKLCH for perceptually uniform steps.

Sumi (墨)

Ink-tinted neutral scale with a subtle blue undertone, inspired by traditional sumi ink.

Blue

Default primary color. Used as the base for the Primary scale when no seasonal theme is active.

Vermillion (朱)

Traditional Japanese vermillion red, used as the accent color.

Green Yellow Amber Purple Seasonal themes

Eight seasonal color themes based on the Japanese 二十四節気 (24 solar terms). Each theme overrides the primary color scale via the{' '} data-season attribute on the root element.

stories.name: Typography
stories.snippet:
const Typography = () => (

Typography

Schatten's typography system provides consistent text styling across the design system. Semantic tokens bundle font size, line height, and weight into named roles — Heading, Body, and Label — so text styles are applied consistently without manual configuration.

Font families

Hanken Grotesk — The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

LINE Seed JP — 素早い茶色の狐が怠惰な犬を飛び越える。

--font-sans: "Hanken Grotesk", "LINE Seed JP", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

Default typeface for UI and body text.

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

--font-serif: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", serif

Serif fallback for editorial content.

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

--font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

Monospace for code and technical content.

Type scale Heading

Used for page titles, section headers, and card headings. Uses semibold/bold weight with snug/tight line height.

Body

For paragraphs, descriptions, and general content. Uses normal weight with relaxed line height for readability.

Label

For interactive elements — form labels, buttons, navigation, and badges. Uses medium weight with tight line height.
